segments.text: Collaborating with AI agents on team documentation usually means copy pasting markdown back and forth from notion or obsidian. Open knowledge is an open-
source AI first alternative that lets you write side by side with your agents.
It features a lossless birectional markdown sync. It connects directly to Claude or cursor via MCP, giving your models live access to your files.
